question: Which of the following is a eukaryotic, multicellular and autotrophic organism?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Plant__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Eukaryotic organisms have cells with a nucleus enclosed within membranes.
 
• Multicellular organisms are composed of more than one cell, with groups of cells differentiating to take on specialized functions.
 
• Autotrophic organisms can produce their own food through photosynthesis or chemosynthesis.
 
• Plants are eukaryotic, multicellular, and autotrophic, capable of photosynthesis using sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water to produce glucose and oxygen.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Fungus
 Eukaryotic, multicellular (mostly) organisms but heterotrophic, not capable of producing their own food.
 
 

 2) Animal
 Eukaryotic, multicellular, heterotrophic organisms, relying on consuming other organisms for food.
 
 

 3) Plant
 Eukaryotic, multicellular, autotrophic organisms, capable of photosynthesis to produce their own food.
 
 

 4) Bacteria
 Prokaryotic, unicellular organisms, with some autotrophic species but lacking a nucleus and other membrane-bound organelles.
